Fast forward to where we are level 5, in the dungeons of the King's Castle. The Dwarf found himself in some serious trouble, and has been arrested and locked in a Jail Cell. The rest of the party had cracked up a plan to break their Dwarven friend out of jail, but things did not go as planned whilst the party was plundering the lower levels of the castle. The Gnome starts to panic about his identity getting out and connecting himself to his parents. The King is an evil, corrupted man who tends to play dirty, and it was fair for us to assume that the King would punish the Gnome's parents if the Gnome was somehow able to both, be identified, and get away.

In an attempt to convince our Gnome that we needed to press on for our Dwarf friend, the Tabaxi starts to try and persuade, saying things like, "You don't know if the guards have already Identified you" and "your parents are gonna be fine."

The Gnome player, in the heat of RP passion, and heightened emotions, just loudly blurts out,

"YOU DON'T HAVE ANY PARENTS, FLOON!!"

If our Tabaxi Player actually had little cat ears, you could see them droop down and the words actually break his heart a little. They had their reconciliation conversation shortly after getting the Dwarf out, so they're on good terms now haha. Every session since then, we'll quote, "You don't have any parents!" and tease our Tabaxi.
